sun-shadow.name: Sun Path & Shadow
vo: Most people guess a twelve metre building casts a twelve metre shadow.
But in a Delhi winter, at four in the afternoon? It's almost forty-three metres.
So don't guess. Pick your city, slide the time, and watch the real shadow move.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

vastu-grid.name: Vastu Grid Overlay
vo: Most people drop a Vastu grid on their plan as if the top of the page is north.
But this plot is turned fifteen degrees. That's two-thirds of a whole zone off.
So set north from your plan's arrow, and every zone lands where it really is.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

sheet-scale.name: Sheet Fit & Scale
vo: Printed your A1 drawing on A3? Most people still read it at one to one hundred.
But it's really one to two hundred, so every length you measure comes out half size.
Pick your sheets, and it gives you the true scale, and the true length.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

stair-designer.name: Staircase Designer
vo: Most people use a one-fifty riser for every house stair.
That's twenty-one risers. N B C allows one ninety for homes: seventeen, and half a metre shorter.
Enter your floor height, and it checks every code limit.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

shading-device.name: Shading Device Sizer
vo: Most people put the same eighteen-inch chajja on every window.
On a south wall, that's close. But face the window west, and you need over two metres.
Pick your city and wall, and it sizes the overhang from real sun angles.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

kitchen-triangle.name: Kitchen Work Triangle
vo: Most people park the fridge wherever there's space, like the far corner.
But that puts it over three metres from the hob. Every leg should stay under two point seven.
Drag the sink, hob and fridge, and it checks every leg, live.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

room-acoustics.name: Room Acoustics RT60
vo: Most people think a few curtains will fix an echoey office.
Curtains still leave one point three seconds. An acoustic ceiling? About half a second.
Enter your room, and it tells you how much absorption to add.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

rainwater-harvest.name: Rainwater Harvesting
vo: Most people size the rainwater tank to hold the whole year's rain.
For this roof, that's sixty-four thousand litres. One heavy-rain day needs just five thousand.
The rest goes to a recharge pit, and every formula is shown.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

lighting-layout.name: Lighting Layout
vo: Most people put four panels in every room, whatever the size.
This six by four and a half metre office needs nine, to reach five hundred lux.
Set your room and fittings, and it lays out the ceiling grid for you.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

daylight-factor.name: Daylight Factor
vo: Most people make the window a tenth of the floor area.
Here that's one point four percent daylight. The office needs one point nine.
Widen the window, and it shows when the room passes.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

ramp-designer.name: Accessible Ramp
vo: Most people take the rise, times twelve.
For a nine-hundred rise, that's ten point eight metres. With landings, it's fifteen point four.
Enter your rise, and it adds every run and landing.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

brick-estimator.name: Brick & Mortar
vo: Most people take cement from the wet mortar volume.
Dry mix needs a quarter more: eight point four bags, not six point six.
Enter your wall and openings, and every step is shown.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

tile-layout.name: Floor Tile Layout
vo: Most people divide the floor area by the tile, and add ten percent.
Here that's twenty-six. Counted tile by tile, it's thirty-one.
Pick your tile and pattern, and it shows every cut.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

room-furnisher.name: Room Furnisher
vo: Most people check that the bed fits, and call the room done.
With a wardrobe, desk and walkways, it needs four metres, not three.
Add the door and window, and it does the layout.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

sliding-sizer.name: Sliding Door & Window
vo: Most people think a two-shutter window opens half its width.
This fifteen-hundred window only opens six hundred and eighty.
Pick your system, and it sizes every shutter and pane of glass.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

plot-envelope.name: Plot Envelope
vo: Most people multiply the plot area by the FAR.
Here that's four eighty square metres. With setbacks and a twelve metre limit, it's four nineteen.
Add your bylaw rules, and it shows which one wins.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

carpet-area.name: Carpet Area
vo: Most people say carpet is seventy percent of super built-up.
With thirty percent loading, this flat's carpet is only sixty-four percent.
Type your room sizes, then slide the loading.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.

cut-fill.name: Cut & Fill
vo: Most people divide the cut by the truck size.
Two hundred cubic metres looks like twenty loads, but dug earth swells, so it's twenty-five.
Set your levels, slide the pad, and it does the rest.
It's free, and the link's in my bio.
